arguments.summary: Fixed Deduper to use half-open windows by treating sightings exactly at the window boundary as new. Added an expiry queue that purges closed key windows on each call, including stale-entry protection for refreshed keys, preventing unbounded memory growth while preserving duplicate suppression.
